entry.title: BLACKENED S84 Shade to Black Coronets — Tin of 10
entry.eyebrow: Creamy Shade over a dark Maduro core
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate or whiskey (projected)
Occasion: Quick rich smoke, coffee pairing, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, cream, cocoa, cedar and black pepper give S84 a smoother contrast between Connecticut Shade and a dark Maduro core. The Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper softens the Broadleaf and Nicaraguan-Pennsylvania Maduro interior rather than turning the cigar mild, leaving chocolate, coffee and pepper beneath the creamy top note. It should be less forceful than M81 but considerably darker and richer than a conventional shade-wrapped cigar.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index lists the exact 4″ × 32 Coronet at A$13 singly and A$119 per tin of 10. The single is currently available but the tin of 10 is unavailable; Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
